subject.title: [Feature]: Session busy status reply + cancel option during long-running model responses

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic channel-visible busy acknowledgement for active session lanes, and what default, config, busy-reason, and cancel/new-session semantics should it expose?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior changes user-visible chat noise, config surface, queue semantics, and destructive action affordances across channels.

options.title: Add a generic core busy acknowledgement
options.body: Implement conservative status text and optional channel-safe actions through the reply pipeline, with tests proving no second model run and no queued-message loss.

options.title: Make it opt-in first
options.body: Add the same core contract behind an explicit config or verbose/status setting to avoid changing default chat noise during rollout.

options.title: Defer to existing queue/status tools
options.body: Leave the issue open only as documentation or diagnostics follow-up, accepting that normal chat surfaces remain quiet during active-session contention.

recommendation.title: Add a generic core busy acknowledgement
recommendation.body: Implement conservative status text and optional channel-safe actions through the reply pipeline, with tests proving no second model run and no queued-message loss.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on the queue-policy extraction and prior review of this exact issue.
